license.notes: Zoo 1.19.0. The gas station's roadside price sign, from docs/SET_DRESSING_REFERENCES.md ('A pylon sign at the road. Tall, freestanding, at the kerb where a driver reads it before the building ... the one a player sees from three streets away. Owner: Zoo (a species) plus Lot (at the frontage, facing the road)') and the proposal's 'dollars-per-gallon to the nine-tenths' (docs/proposals/GAS_STATION_SHOP.md). A concrete plinth, two steel posts, a brand cabinet (FLAPPHAS, in the coffee sign's colourways), a price cabinet (REGULAR, PLUS, SUPER, each to the 9/10) and an OPEN 24 HRS strip, every cabinet lit on both faces from one backlit image (M_Pylon_<art>_Face, Lux's power cut takes it), the back face reversed so both read. Two submissions: painted steel (colours in the Wear vertex colour) and the glow. Invented brand. Collision is the slot's box.
